info.syllabusName: Quản lý sự thay đổi (Change Management)
info.description: The primary purpose of this course is to provide a basis for accreditation of people involved with Change Management at the foundation level. This foundation level is designed to measure whether a candidate has sufficient knowledge and understanding of the Change Management Text and Handbook to act as an informed member of a change management team during a period of change within part or all of their organization. This course is aimed at individuals who are involved in change programmes or organizations going through change, who require a working knowledge of the key principles of change management, who need to know the terminology used and some of the theory behind the practice.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand the concepts, principles, model types, approaches and roles
Apply particular models or approaches relating to the syllabus area to a given scenario (By implication this must include how a model or approach should not be used.)
Analyse and distinguish between appropriate and inappropriate use of particular approaches and models within the context of the scenario.
Plan and organize change management for marketing activities related to specific business cases
Research and discover how to combine change management and marketing knowledge
Perfect the use of English in changing business environment
Master communication skills with customers and partners using change management theories to meet the business targets
Display positive attitude in learning new knowledge, knowing how to solve different situations in business based on theories in change management
